## Clean data

### Load libraries

```{R}
library("tidyverse")
```

### Rename columns

```{R}
prostate_cancer <- read_csv(file = "data/prostate_cancer.csv", 
                        show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  
# Columns are renamed for better description
  rename(
  patient_num = patno,
  estrogen_treatment = rx,
  follow_up_months = dtime, 
  weight = wt, 
  performance = pf, 
  heart_disease_history = hx,
  systolic_bp_10 = sbp,
  diastolic_bp_10 = dbp,
  baseline_electrocardiogram = ekg,
  serum_hemoglobin = hg,
  primary_tumor_size= sz, 
  stage_and_histological_grade = sg,
  prostatic_acid_phosphatase = ap,
  bone_metastasis = bm,
  )
```

### Unpack status column

```{R}
cancer_data_c1 <- prostate_cancer |>
separate_wider_delim(
  status,
  delim = " - ",
  names = c("vital_status", "death_cause"),
  too_few = "align_start"
)
```

### Replace non-descriptive abbreviations

```{R}
cancer_data_c2 <- cancer_data_c1 |>
  mutate(
    death_cause = str_replace(death_cause, " ca$", " cancer"),
    baseline_electrocardiogram = case_match(
      baseline_electrocardiogram,
      "heart block or conduction def" ~ "heart block or conduction defect",
      "old MI" ~ "old myocardial infarction",
      "rhythmic disturb & electrolyte ch" ~ "rhythmic disturbance and electrolyte changes",
      .default = baseline_electrocardiogram
    )
  )
```

### Data split

```{R}
# Splited the cleaned dataset by patient attributes, and treatment and follow-up outcomes, linked by patient number.

patient_baseline <- cancer_data_c2 |>
  select(
    patient_num, 
    stage, 
    age, 
    weight, 
    performance,
    heart_disease_history, 
    systolic_bp_10, 
    diastolic_bp_10,
    baseline_electrocardiogram, 
    serum_hemoglobin, 
    primary_tumor_size,
    stage_and_histological_grade,
    prostatic_acid_phosphatase, 
    bone_metastasis
  )

treatment_outcomes <- cancer_data_c2 |>
  select(
    patient_num, 
    estrogen_treatment, 
    follow_up_months,
    vital_status, 
    death_cause
  )
```

### Storing files

```{R}
write_csv(x = patient_baseline, file = "data/patient_baseline_clean.csv")
write_csv(x = treatment_outcomes, file = "data/treatment_outcomes_clean.csv")
```
